messages.text: This is frustrating.  But understandable.  What would be a huge thank you for everyone from phase 1 that stayed with it, is to offer a second chance within 60 days of delivery to pick up another one at that introductory price.  This allows a full 60 day evaluation, and an informed decision/review of what was promised vs the actuality.  I for one, if this does live up to or exceed expectations, would probably buy a second.     Food for thought.  Pat    Sent from my iPhone
